phase: Phase 32: Autonomous Fleet Mesh Congestion Control & Adaptive PHY

stories.title: Dynamic BLE Advertising Interval Throttler & Flooding Redundancy Governor
stories.description: Implement MeshCongestionGovernor.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ dynamically adjusting BLE advertising intervals (20ms to 250ms) and probabilistic flooding suppression based on local node density and channel utilization.
acceptanceCriteria: Throttles BLE advertisement intervals dynamically when RF channel utilization exceeds 70%
Applies probabilistic relay dampening for non-emergency flooded packets in high-density clusters
Maintains zero latency degradation for emergency SOS frames

stories.title: Adaptive Multi-PHY Switcher Engine (LE 1M, LE 2M, LE Coded S8)
stories.description: Implement AdaptivePhySwitcher.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ dynamically negotiating Bluetooth 5.0 PHY modes (LE 2M for high throughput at close range, LE Coded S8 for 4x long range through mountain passes).
acceptanceCriteria: Switches to LE 2M when link quality score > 85 and RSSI > -65 dBm
Switches to LE Coded S8 when RSSI drops below -85 dBm or packet drop exceeds 15%
Provides hysteresis dampening to prevent rapid PHY flapping

stories.title: Hardware Bridge Multi-PHY Binding & Tactical Cockpit RF Pill Telemetry
stories.description: Wire AdaptivePhySwitcher and MeshCongestionGovernor into IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iOS). Update MainCockpitScreen with tactile RF PHY pills (2M / 1M / S8) and channel congestion indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Streams live PHY and channel congestion metrics to UI state
Exposes reactive observation closures to iOS SwiftUI with CancellationHandle
Renders glove-friendly high-contrast RF status badge in cockpit header
Compiles cleanly on Android and iOS targets

stories.title: 24-Node High-Density RF Congestion Simulation & Range Benchmark Test
stories.description: Implement FleetMeshCongestionSimulationTest.kt simulating 24 nodes under severe 2.4 GHz channel saturation, validating automatic PHY step-downs, collision avoidance, and voice delivery guarantees.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 24 nodes transmitting voice, telemetry, and control traffic simultaneously
Verifies channel utilization throttling and automated PHY switching
